issue.title: [vxlan][cisco-8000] VXLAN tunnel DECAP_TTL_MODE inconsistent with IP-in-IP decap tunnels causes orchagent tunnel programming failure

failure.body:
### Description

On `cisco-8000` platforms, the base topology IP-in-IP decap tunnels are created with **pipe** TTL mode. When the VXLAN tunnel is created by the sonic-mgmt test code without an explicit `ttl_mode`, `DECAP_TTL_MODE` is not consistent with the already-programmed IP-in-IP decap tunnels, and `orchagent` fails to program the VXLAN tunnel correctly.

As a result, VXLAN/VNET tests that create a `VXLAN_TUNNEL` entry fail on cisco-8000 DUTs.

### Failure type

Day-one issue — the test framework never set `ttl_mode` on the `VXLAN_TUNNEL` config entry, so cisco-8000 has always hit the inconsistent `DECAP_TTL_MODE` condition.

### Affected platform / branches

- Platform / asic_type: `cisco-8000` (validated on Cisco 8101 and 8122)
- Branches: `master`, `202605`

### Affected tests

- `tests/vxlan/test_vxlan_decap.py`
- `tests/vxlan/test_vnet_decap.py`
- `tests/vxlan/test_vxlan_ecmp.py`
- `tests/vxlan/test_vxlan_ecmp_switchover.py`
- `tests/vxlan/test_vxlan_bfd_tsa.py`
- `tests/vxlan/test_vxlan_route_advertisement.py`
- `tests/vxlan/test_vxlan_tunnel_route_scale.py`
- `tests/vxlan/test_vxlan_vnet_bgp_subintf.py`
- `tests/vxlan/test_scale_ecmp.py`
- `tests/acl/test_src_mac_rewrite.py`

### Expected behavior

When the DUT `asic_type` is `cisco-8000`, the test framework should create the `VXLAN_TUNNEL` entry with `ttl_mode = pipe` so that `DECAP_TTL_MODE` matches the existing IP-in-IP decap tunnels and `orchagent` programs the tunnel successfully.

### Fix

Set `ttl_mode=pipe` for cisco-8000 in the VXLAN tunnel creation path:

- Per-test call sites updated to pass `ttl_mode`: https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/26084 (merged)
- Follow-up: auto-default `ttl_mode` to `pipe` inside the shared `VxLAN_Utils.create_vxlan_tunnel()` helper (`tests/common/vxlan_ecmp_utils.py`) so every caller is covered: https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/26659

### Backport request

This issue tracks the backport/cherry-pick of the above PRs to:

- [x] 202605

### Test evidence

Attached to the linked PRs (`test_vnet_decap`, `test_vxlan_decap`, and `test_vxlan_multi_tunnel` logs from Cisco 8101 / 8122).

resolution.title: [tests/vxlan]: Set VXLAN tunnel ttl_mode=pipe for cisco-8000 platforms
resolution.description:

Summary:
Fixes #26669

On cisco-8000, the base topology IP-in-IP decap tunnels already use pipe TTL mode. When VxLAN DECAP_TTL_MODE is not set consistently, orchagent fails to program the tunnel correctly. Set the ttl mode during vxlan tunnel creation if platform is cisco-8000.
